entries.ee8acbbe6f8eb659: This business provides BPO (business process outsourcing) and consulting, undertaking the operations of companies and government agencies as an external specialist firm. The operations it undertakes are wide-ranging, from clerical work such as reception and order processing for private companies, payroll calculation, data entry, and IT work such as telemarketing and technical support, to general counter services for local governments. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135,391 million (up 24.3% year on year), and it is the 4th largest of the 5 reportable [[term:segment|segments]], but it has the highest growth rate. The revenue increase includes revenue of ¥23,214 million (¥4,053 million in the prior fiscal year) from PERSOL Communication Services Co., Ltd. (formerly Fujitsu Communication Services Co., Ltd.), acquired in February 2025.
entries.f082b21fabdc5a28: In July 2017, the company changed its trade name from Temp Holdings Co., Ltd. to PERSOL HOLDINGS CO.,LTD.
